subject: Rights and use carveouts for NovaCorp order form
messages:
From: Mike Turner <mike.turner@novacorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Rights and training carveouts for NovaCorp order form

Ben —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement and legal reviewed the draft order form and came back with a couple of asks related to output ownership and training:

- We need a broad right to use and commercialize outputs from the integration (productization) for our own customers.
- We want the ability to retrain our internal models using outputs + sanitized logs in future products (we can pay an incremental fee).
- We also want a feedback/telemetry license so we can incorporate closed-loop signals into our dev process.

I attached our redlines (novacorp_redlines.docx) — redline summary on page 2. Can you flag the absolute blockers and propose language we can take back to our legal team?

Also copying procurement (procurement@novacorp.com) to keep the timeline visible — ideally we need a final order form signed within two weeks for Q3 rollout.

Appreciate the help —
Mike Turner
Sr. Dir, AI Products
NovaCorp

[Attachment: novacorp_redlines.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Turner <mike.turner@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rights and training carveouts for NovaCorp order form

Mike — thanks for the clear summary and the redlines. I skimmed the doc; looping in Karthik (sales ops) and Laura (legal) to get a tight proposal back to you. Quick thoughts up front so you have the tradeoffs: 

- Output commercialization: we can grant a non-exclusive right to use, display, and distribute outputs produced by your integration for commercialization of your product. We are not able to transfer model ownership or assign the models themselves.

- Training/retraining: we generally do not include a blanket right to retrain Redwood-owned models using service outputs. That said, we can offer a paid addendum (one-time or periodic fee) that grants a narrowly scoped retraining license limited to sanitized customer outputs and only for your internal models, with audit/telemetry controls.

- Feedback/telemetry license: we can provide a license to use aggregated/ de-identified telemetry and feedback for product improvement. We need to carve out personal data and logs that contain customer PII.

Proposed compromise options for the order form (we'll let legal turn into language):
 A) Productization rights (included): non-exclusive license to outputs for NovaCorp internal and customer-facing productization; no model assignment; standard attribution and export controls.
 B) Training addendum (optional/paid): limited retrain license, data-sanitization obligations, time-bound consent, and evidence/attestation requirements.

If A/B are acceptable, Laura can prepare redlined language. Karthik — can you confirm whether procurement prefers a single-signature order form + addendum or two separate agreements?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Turner <mike.turner@novacorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rights and training carveouts for NovaCorp order form

Mike/Ben —

Thanks — I reviewed the redlines. High-level: NovaCorp's asks are normal but we need to be careful to preserve Redwood's model IP and commercial safeguards. Attached is an initial suggested redline for the order form that implements Ben's A/B compromise and a short schedule describing evidence requirements (orderform_redline_nb.docx).

Key legal points in our suggested text: 
- "Outputs": defined as text generated by the service in response to customer prompts; NovaCorp receives a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right to use and commercialize Outputs subject to export/usage restrictions and attribution.
- No transfer of models or weights; language explicitly prohibits assignment or sale of Redwood models.
- Training license: available only via a separate Data & Retraining Addendum, with (i) required data-sanitization steps, (ii) security controls, (iii) a one-year lookback provisioning window, and (iv) audit rights for Redwood to validate sanitized sets.
- Feedback license: limited to aggregated/ de-identified signals; no raw user prompt logs without an executed DPA amendment.

Operational asks for NovaCorp: we will need a brief statement of the telemetry you intend to capture and retention period. We can keep retention to 90 days by default; longer retention requires additional review.

If you can confirm A/B (productization + optional training addendum), we will convert the attached into a redlined PDF and send back. If you have specific wording you need in the productization clause (e.g., sublicensing downstream customers), call that out and we can triage.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

[Attachment: orderform_redline_nb.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Turner <mike.turner@novacorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rights and training carveouts for NovaCorp order form

Mike — quick ops note from our side on practical constraints if we move forward with the Addendum path: 

- Sanitization workflow: NovaCorp will need to provide a sanitized dataset in prescribed format (JSONL or Parquet). Our security onboarding requires an attestation checklist and a one-time mini-audit for the first dataset.
- Retention and telemetry: default retention for request/response logs is 90 days; TTL can be extended to 365 days with approval and additional controls.
- Deployment controls: if you want to run retraining using Redwood compute, we'll need to scope GPU time and an SOW for compute costs. If you retrain on-prem, the Addendum is lighter but still requires telemetry redaction.

Next steps I suggest: 
1) Laura finalizes redlines into a PDF we can send to you (Ben/Laura).
2) If NovaCorp agrees to the Addendum concept, procurement sends a short confirmation email with the preferred path (Redwood-managed retrain vs NovaCorp-managed).
3) We prepare a DocuSign envelope for the order form + Addendum (if requested).

Ben/Sean — any objections before I draft the SOW bullets?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

[Note: internal ops constraints summarized — not a contractual commitment until signed.]

From: Mike Turner <mike.turner@novacorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rights and training carveouts for NovaCorp order form

Ben/Karthik/Laura —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear options. NovaCorp is aligned with Option A (productization rights as drafted) and would like to proceed with Option B (training addendum) as a paid, optional addendum — NovaCorp prefers to manage retraining on-prem for now, but we may request Redwood-managed retrain later. Procurement has confirmed the procurement cadence and will expect DocuSign by EOW next week.

Requested minor tweaks: 
- Please make sure the productization clause explicitly allows NovaCorp to sublicense outputs to its end customers (we can accept reasonable export controls).
- Extend telemetry retention to 180 days in the Addendum (NovaCorp is willing to accept the associated attestation/audit).

If those are acceptable, we can sign the order form + attach the Addendum as a separate document. Please send the DocuSign link when ready.

Thanks —
Mike Turner
Sr. Dir, AI Products | NovaCorp
procurement@novacorp.com

[Attachment: redlined_orderform.pdf]
